verdict.rationale: Radar documents a review queue and an API endpoint to approve reviews. However, nothing in the evidence shows reviewer assignment, escalation paths, SLA tracking, or an audit trail recording who approved what and why. The review queue is an adjacent feature and does not deliver the team-workflow capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an ops user, review work is a team workflow — assignment, escalation, SLAs, and a decision audit trail that shows who approved what and why
